item.title: The Clock Has Changed. Have Our Foundations?
item.description: Look at the picture for a moment. In the middle sits a pile of shared building blocks: open source libraries, base images, certificates, models. Nobody owns all of it. Everybody depends on it. Around it are the places we actually run software: a desk at home, an office, a cloud account, a data center. Between them, small figures run back and forth, carrying blocks.

item.title: AI-Native Companies Will Outlearn Everyone Else
item.description:
Most companies think AI is about productivity.

It is not.

AI is about organizational learning.

The companies that define the next decade will not necessarily have the largest teams or the deepest funding. They will be the ones that learn faster than everyone else.
